messages:
tess (CS): Quick heads-up — LedgerLane onboarding: 2-week ramp, but we’re seeing intermittent latency spikes during peak chat traffic. customer mentioned renewal in ~8 weeks, flagging as a potential risk. Thinking we should propose a short quantized canary + routing fallback to reduce cost and smooth p95.
aman (ML Eng): +1 to a targeted int8 pilot. From similar customers, int8 gave ~35-50% token-cost drop; p50 hit ~+8–12ms, p95 depends on request length. Need sample request distribution and 48h traffic window.
lucy (AE): I can schedule enablement material and a quick walkthrough with their infra team. If CS + ML agree on rollout plan, I’ll get a week-of calendar slot.
tess (CS): Sharing the perf snapshot here: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ledgerlane/onboard/perf?panel=latency — main spikes cluster around 11:30–12:30 PST and 17:00–18:00 PST (batch of ~20 req/s).
aman (ML Eng): Perfect. Can we start with a 10% canary to compact-1-int8 for chat.generate, 90% stays on prod full-precision? Canary for 48h with traffic-routing and automatic rollback on error rate >1% or p95 +30%?
marco (Infra): Proposed routing rule — can push via our feature-routing service.
marco (Infra): ```
route: ledgerlane-chat
- match: { customer_id: "ledgerlane", endpoint: "/chat.generate" }
  stable: full-prec-v2
  canary: compact-1-int8
  canary_percent: 10
  rollback_on: { errors_pct: 1, p95_increase_pct: 30 }
  duration: 48h
```
ops-bot: Deploy plan created by marco — canary will start when ML uploads the int8 artifact. ID: deploy-LL-4955.
aman (ML Eng): Uploading int8 artifact now. Quick note: we added a KV prefix cache for common prompts which helped p95 for short chats. If we can't safely quantize some ops, we'll route those by prefix to full model.
tess (CS): Important — customer uses a lot of product-key lookups in prompts. Recommend opt-in prefix-routing so sensitive queries always hit full-prec. Also need to capture customer feedback after 24h.
lucy (AE): I'll add a checkbox to the enablement doc: "Prefer full-precision for prompts containing API_KEY or FINANCE.*" and send to LedgerLane.
aman (ML Eng): After 24h canary update (internal sim): cost down 42% for canary traffic, p50 +9ms, p95 +28ms. No error rate increase. Suggest keep 10% for another 24h then bump to 30% if stable. Also enable fallback: if model returns error 500 -> immediately route to full-prec and mark session for review.
marco (Infra): Fallback snippet we can reuse: ```
fallbacks:
  - condition: response.status >= 500
    action: route_to: full-prec-v2
    mark: "quant-fallback"
```
tess (CS): Solid — I'll summarize for customer: cost win + tiny latency trade, automatic fallback, and optional prefix-exemption for sensitive prompts. I'll capture feedback and surface any hallucination/regression reports.
lucy (AE): Scheduling 30-min enablement + Q&A for Friday 10:00 PST. Will share calendar and checklist.
tess (CS): Noted — tagging renewal team. If canary stays healthy, we can present this as an ROI play at renewal (projected ~30–40% token cost reduction for their current mix). :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Canary deploy started (deploy-LL-4955) — 10% traffic to compact-1-int8. Monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ledgerlane/onboard/canary?view=metrics
aman (ML Eng): I'll monitor the eval set and run automated quality checks. If anything regresses beyond 2% F1 drop on our prompt set, we rollback.
tess (CS): Thanks team — I'll log this as an At-Risk > Proactive optimization item in customer health (ticket #CS-7892) and update the renewal playbook.
lucy (AE): I’ll push the invite and the enablement deck shortly.
aman (ML Eng): ping me if you want me on the call to explain fallback mechanics.
tess (CS): Will do. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the canary + routing plan.
